items.headline: Low Water Advisory issued November 26 at 10:41PM CST until November 27 at 9:00PM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.description:
* WHAT...Abnormally low water levels.

* WHERE...Galveston Bay.

* WHEN...Until 9 PM CST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Below normal water levels will result in hazardous
navigating conditions.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Water levels in the northern portion of
Galveston Bay expected to be around -0.9 to -1.5 ft MLLW during
low tide Friday afternoon/early evening.
items.instruction:
Mariners should navigate shallow waters with extreme caution due
to below normal water levels.
